name: Discouragement
overview: Scripture addresses discouragement by assuring believers of God's constant presence and faithfulness, encouraging them to trust Him fully rather than rely on their own understanding. God's promise to go before His people and never forsake them calls for courage and strength in the face of fear and dismay. Believers are reminded to place their hope in the Lord, who strengthens the heart and has plans of peace and a hopeful future, even when circumstances seem bleak or unbelief arises.
